_note: WSR collision mesh (WS2_glf_course_<id>.kcl.obj, wszst export) -> NSS hole number. Established 2026-10-15 from tee-pad to green distances (1 mesh unit = 0.1 m, 9.144 units/yd; every hole within 20 yd of the in-game yardage), from projecting the app's catalogued pins onto the mesh greens (36/36 land inside), and from visual matching against the minimaps. Front nine = Famicom Golf JP-course holes (fcJP*), back nine = NES Golf US-course holes (fc*), specials = fcJP2/19/14.
